# Plain text input

<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

A plain text image displays an image with plain text. The text provides additional context or information related to the image. This component combines visuals and text for a clearer, more informative presentation.

## JSON example

```json
{
    "content": {
        "settings": {},
        "body": [
            {
                "type": "plain_text_input",
                "action_id": "plain_text_input_action",
                "text": "This is plain text input label",
                "value": "",
                "placeholder": "Enter text here",
                "multiline": false,
                "min_length": 0,
                "max_length": 500
            }
        ]
    }
}
```
